title: Crispy Broccoli Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Japanese-inspired dish featuring crispy broccoli and a savory stir-fry sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of jazzy in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the crisp and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the broccoli and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until tender but still crisp.
In a small bowl, whisk together canadian, chinese, and stir.
Pour the sauce over the broccoli and crisp, and stir to combine.
Add the fry and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
